newsitem.title: USA: WMX seen poised for major announcement.
newsitem.headline: WMX seen poised for major announcement.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc may be ready to make a major announcement, such as a corporate restructuring or big share repurchase, judging from the way it plans to release quarterly results Tuesday, analysts said.
A company spokesman said WMX will distribute fourth quarter results for itself and affiliated entities all at once before the market opens on Tuesday.

"The one other time this happened, they were announcing a reorganization and restructuring," said CS First Boston industry analyst Michael Hoffman. "It would seem they've sent a message that there will be a major announcement tomorrow."
Shares in the Oak Brook, Ill.-based trash hauling company were off 1/2 to 36-1/8 in New York Stock Exchange trading.
WMX has been under heavy pressure from shareholders over recent months to improve its performance.
